summary: Editas Medicine filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of common stock and pre-funded/common stock warrants. The combined offering includes shares of common stock plus warrants exercisable at a fixed price with a milestone-based or 3-year expiration, and pre-funded warrants exercisable at $0.0001. The offering price per unit is to be determined; the last sale price was $2.76. The underwriters include Cantor and Wells Fargo. Proceeds go to the company. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
